# Modern Snake Game (Pythonic) - Full Technical & Strategic Documentation

## Overview
Modern Snake (https://pythonics.vercel.app/) is a modern browser arcade game developed in Vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas. It delivers an instant-loading, 60FPS gaming experience with zero ads, zero tracking, and complete offline PWA functionality.

## Core Rules & Gameplay
- The player steers a snake on a 20x20 lattice grid.
- Eating regular apples increases snake length by 1 tile and awards base points multiplied by the current level.
- Rapid successive collections trigger a Combo Multiplier up to 4x.
- Colliding with the perimeter wall (in standard mode) or the snake's own body terminates the round.
- The game features 8 active power-ups (Speed, Freeze, Ghost, 2x Score, Magnet, Food Frenzy, Shrink, Shield) that introduce dynamic tactical decision-making.

Provides step-by-step PWA install instructions for Chromebooks, Windows, and mobile devices, along with short-burst survival tactics.

### Article 2: The Mathematical Limit of Snake: Can a Human Beat the Hamiltonian Cycle World Record?
- **URL**: https://pythonics.vercel.app/blog/maximum-score-snake-hamiltonian-cycle
- **Author**: Nikhil Nishad
- **Published**: September 21, 2026
- **Summary**: Mathematical analysis of the 20x20 Snake grid. Proves the theoretical maximum length of 399-400 tiles and demystifies discrete graph theory's Hamiltonian cycle. Explains why robotic Hamiltonian play requires ~79,000 moves and 4+ hours, and details how human speedrunners use serpentine S-curves, perimeter highways, and tail-tracking heuristics to achieve near-100% board fill in under 12 minutes.
